source: Built-in imagegen; edits derived from existing original generated skyline.png
city_prompt: Edit the supplied wide industrial skyline game texture into a SEPARATE STATIC CITY LAYER with a genuinely transparent sky. Preserve the exact original ruined industrial buildings, distant and foreground silhouette tiers, every chimney position, muted steel-blue / charcoal palette, fine crisp pixel clusters and side-view composition. Remove ALL clouds from the sky and ALL smoke plumes from chimney tops, leaving genuine transparent alpha in the sky and between skyline structures. Keep every chimney itself intact. Preserve the softly hazy distant buildings and darker foreground ruins; their atmospheric fading may use alpha, but don't introduce an opaque sky rectangle. The city buildings must occupy the SAME lower portion and SAME locations as in the input panorama, with transparent empty sky above; do not crop, zoom, rearrange or invent towers. Entire input panorama framing, ideally same2048x683 wide aspect. Absolutely no clouds, no smoke, no sunset painted behind buildings, no new text or frames. This transparent static city will be layered in front of separately animated pixel clouds and animated chimney smoke in the game.
cloud_prompt: Derive a SEPARATELY MOVABLE CLOUD LAYER from the supplied panoramic pixel-art skyline. Preserve its exact dark stormcloud pixel-cluster texture, charcoal/slate/navy colors, restrained rusty sunset light under the lower thin clouds. Output same wide 2048x683 panorama framing. Keep ONLY the clouds: many varied broad irregular dark cloud banks across top two-thirds and sparse thin horizontal broken cloud ribbons toward lower sky. Remove ALL buildings, ALL terrain and ALL chimney smoke. All gaps between clouds and the lower area must have genuine transparent alpha, no opaque sky gradient. Horizontally tileable cloud density at left/right edge, large masses with detailed crisp angular pixel clusters and softly layered pixel shading, no smooth vectors, no round cartoon puffs, no typography. Not a scenery painting: a reusable transparent clouds-only game layer for slow horizontal parallax drift. Preserve the exact original stormy industrial pixel-art game style and visible texture resolution, atmospheric dark density and shape language. Lower edge may taper toward transparency to leave sunset horizon visible.
usage: Separate opaque/alpha city silhouettes and cloud banks. Cloud UV layers drift independently; skyline remains fixed. Small chimney smoke is animated in matching slate pixel clusters by scripts/background_atmosphere.gd. The original skyline.png is retained for provenance.
